raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 has about 400 rows instead of the usual ~340, and its ingest_ts runs from 02:00 to 22:00. This looks like a partial re-delivery or replay appended inside the same batch, which put 23 extra rows into raw_transactions (4825 rows but only 4802 distinct txn_id); 22 of those keys are POSTED and are double-counted in silver and every gold table. The fix assumes the replayed rows are redeliveries of the same transactions, since I couldn't confirm their contents. It deduplicates on txn_id, keeping the most recently ingested version, and only then applies the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) d WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
